message: Use the latest ARM common-types version 'v6' instead of 'v3'.
Each resource interface must have an @armResourceOperations decorator.
Per the Noun_Verb convention for Operation Ids, the noun 'CustomItems' should not appear after the underscore.
Please provide x-ms-examples describing minimum/maximum property set for response/request payloads for operations.
PUT 200/201 response models should be Azure resources and must carry x-ms-azure-resource semantics.
